target.title: Add local Claw feed planning
target.body:
## Summary

Stacked after #101328. This adds the first read-only Claw feed layer so OpenClaw can discover a Claw from a feed entry and build the same lifecycle plan introduced in PR2.

- adds `openclaw.clawFeed.v1` types, strict parsing, and local feed file reading
- resolves feed entries to local Claw manifest sources with source-locality checks
- adds owner/trust metadata on feed entries and warnings for missing owner evidence
- adds `openclaw claws feed inspect <feed>` and `openclaw claws feed plan <feed> <claw>`
- keeps PR3 read-only: remote feed fetch, install, mutation, and ClawHub publish/search stay deferred

## Safety / ownership behavior

- relative feed sources must stay under the feed file directory
- absolute local paths are rejected
- remote `http`/`https` sources are rejected in this PR
- `file:` URLs are accepted only if they resolve under the feed directory
- feed entry id must match the resolved manifest id
- feed entry version mismatch is diagnostic-only warning so feeds can surface drift without mutating anything

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/feed.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws feed inspect src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json --json`
- `OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR=/tmp/openclaw-claws-pr3-proof-state node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws feed plan src/claws/fixtures/local-claws.feed.json incident-response --json`
- `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --pretty false --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node src/claws/feed.ts src/claws/types.ts src/claws/schema.ts src/claws/plan.ts src/claws/reader.ts src/cli/claws-cli.ts src/cli/claws-cli.runtime.ts`

## Notes

I also attempted full-project typecheck paths:

- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` could not run because `node_modules/.bin/tsgo` is missing in this worktree.
- direct `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false` OOMed at the default heap and again with `--max-old-space-size=8192`.
